data.title: Cavan Sullivan hits historic new heights with Philadelphia Union - Yahoo Sports
data.content: For Cavan Sullivan, that has been the story of his breakout 2026 season. Fresh off his historic USMNT debut, the 17-year-old midfielder delivered two assists on Saturday as the Philadelphia Union extended their club-record unbeaten streak to 13 matches with a 2-1 win over Real Salt Lake at Subaru Park. Even in a game where he wasn't electric in the way he has been in most games, he still has a hand in the first goal for the assist, and then he kind of makes the play that leads to the action for the second goal. The Union's remarkable resurgence has now stretched to 13 matches unbeaten (11W-0L-2D) since returning from the 2026 FIFA World Cup break, a club record for a team that sat at the bottom of the league standings during the first half of the season.
